compatibility: session_event keeps its ten columns, so previous positional writers and readers work unchanged during the window; consumers read provenance only once the migration is active
evidence_class: mocked: a SQLite catalog file stands in for the central session database; previous release writers and readers are reproduced by their positional statements; no embedding provider runs, vectors are fixture rows

fixture_inputs.interrupted_backfill: a backfill that stops inside its third batch and resumes after a restart
fixture_inputs.mismatched_vector_dimension: two vectors of dimension four under an index generation registered at dimension three
fixture_inputs.new_optional_fields: trust class and project state per event, written by the new writer and backfilled for older rows
fixture_inputs.previous_schema: a catalog file created without the event provenance table, written by the previous positional writer

interfaces: hooks.memory.catalog.Catalog creates session_event_provenance and Catalog.commit writes provenance in the event transaction
hooks.memory.migrations.Migrator.add, startup, status, backfill, verify, activate, deactivate and provenance
hooks.memory.migrations.VectorDimensions.blocked and drop with an operator Approval
python -m scripts.swarm_v2.migrations status|startup|backfill|verify|activate|deactivate|drop-vectors over a catalog file
metrics: migration_rows_remaining from Migrator.status after startup, during the window, during an interruption and after the backfill

outcomes.accepted: each backfill batch and its cursor commit in one transaction under a compare and set revision
outcomes.committed: provenance rows for every event, verified before activation
outcomes.externally_verified: none; no deployed catalog was migrated
outcomes.observed: case outputs in the a, b and c result files from the focused proof run

remaining_limitations: No service calls Migrator.startup or runs the backfill on a schedule yet; an operator runs the command line.
Dropping session_event_provenance or schema_migration needs a reviewed rollback migration that is not written.
A model with a different dimension still needs its own index generation registered by the index worker.
rollback_rehearsal: C deactivated the active projection: provenance reads were refused, the table kept all nine rows, previous readers saw ten columns and nine rows, and activation succeeded again without a new backfill
supported_versions: previous release catalogs without session_event_provenance and their positional event writer and readers; this release's writer
